title: Cancel (surrender) a liquor licence
summary: This page explains how to permanently cancel (surrender) a liquor licence using the Liquor Licence Manager.
intro:
To cancel your liquor licence permanently submit a completed surrender liquor licence form using the Liquor Licence Manager.

To temporarily cease trading for 6 weeks or longer, you need to lodge a cease to trade notification.

For up-to-date liquor licence guidelines, resources and tools visit Liquor & Gaming NSW liquor licensing.

If you have questions or feedback about liquor licensing contact Liquor & Gaming NSW.
who_can_apply: Must be ready to permanently cancel (surrender) the liquor licence.
what_you_need: Personal details of the licensee (if an individual)
ABN, ACN, or Y/Inc of the licensee (if an organisation)
Details of how remaining liquor will be disposed of
Representative's name and contact details (if applicable)
Signed declaration of the applicant (individual or organisation)
Consent and signature of the relevant party

how_to_steps.text: Select the 'Go to Liquor Licence Manager' button.
Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Go to 'Surrender liquor licence' and select 'Apply'.
Follow the prompts to submit your application to surrender a liquor licence.

faqs.a: You need to lodge a cease to trade notification.
